question: What is the value of (1 ÷ 8) of 512 - {- 5 ÷ 0.5} × 6 ?
solution:
Given:

(1 ÷ 8) of 512 - {- 5 ÷ 0.5} × 6

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83ad200c05af7ff0a96c689e1309a38eee4e23c73e3e9636ad108a7806b6c852.png] 

Calculation:

(1 ÷ 8) of 512 - {- 5 ÷ 0.5} × 6

⇒ 1/8 × 512 - {- 5 ÷ 0.5} × 6

⇒ 64 - (-10) × 6

⇒ 64 + 60

⇒ 124

∴ The simplified value is 124.
